proposed.explanation: TMGH shows strong fundamental momentum that suits a long-term, high-risk-tolerance investor with a 10+ year horizon. Key positives: (1) EPS grew from 4.38 EGP in 2024 to 6.98 EGP in 2025, a ~59% increase; (2) Gross profit rose ~49% year-over-year (from 14.0 B EGP to 20.9 B EGP); (3) The P/E at the current price of 82.50 EGP is roughly 11.8×, which is reasonable for a company growing earnings at this pace; (4) ROE is approximately 11.5% (net profit 18.2 B / equity 157.7 B), indicating efficient capital use; (5) Total equity of 157.7 B EGP suggests a solid balance-sheet base. The investor has no existing holdings, so this would be the first position. The diversification rule caps any single stock at 50% of total portfolio value (100,000 EGP), so the maximum affordable position is 606 shares (606 × 82.50 = 49,995 EGP), leaving 50,005 EGP in cash. I recommend buying the full 606 shares to maximise exposure within the constraint. Risks and caveats: I only have one verified year of net profit (2025); the 2024 net-profit figure is unreadable (covered by an auditor's stamp), so I cannot confirm the exact net-profit growth rate—only the EPS growth is fully verified. I also lack data on debt levels, dividend policy, sector competition, and forward guidance. The ~87% net-to-gross-profit ratio is unusual and may reflect a holding-company or financial-services structure; without a revenue line I cannot fully assess operating leverage. This is guidance, not a guarantee; the stock could decline on macro, sector, or company-specific shocks. The investor should monitor subsequent filings for confirmation of the growth trend.
